class_definition.copy_of_a_file_outside_the_unread_famili: same sha256 as a results/ payload outside the unread membership
class_definition.copy_of_a_latest_twin: same sha256 as a file whose name carries 'latest' (survives a vintage retirement)
class_definition.repeat_of_another_member_in_the_same_fam: same sha256 as another member of the same family
class_definition.unique_bytes: no byte-identical partner anywhere in the results/ payload tree

method_limits: byte identity is the only witness: a vintage that differs by one timestamp field counts as unique even when it carries no new measurement
the corpus is results/ payload extensions only; a partner in docs/ or in a non-payload extension is not seen, so the duplicate count is a lower bound
the population is E472's rows as published; a family that gained or lost members since then is reported through members_missing_on_disk, never silently rescanned
bytes_lost_if_retired counts family repeats as lost even when the whole family is retired together (the bytes are identical to each other, not to anything that survives)
